about: A supporter of Aegon the Uncrowned against Maegor.
Jason’s death left her governing Casterly Rock for Loreon. Dalton’s raids devastated the coast, but she later defeated ironborn forces and carried the war to their islands.
He appears at Ashford in The Hedge Knight’s graphic adaptation.
He entered the throne room with Roland Crakehall and found Jaime after Aerys’s murder.
Captivity kept him away when Jeyne married Robb. Pardoned after the Red Wedding, he later helped urge Riverrun’s surrender.

She joined Robb’s household and survived Riverrun’s siege before returning west.
Robb’s squire became the presumed heir to the Crag after Raynald’s disappearance.
Recognised as Ossifer’s heir despite rumours that Aegon IV fathered him. The circumstances invite suspicion, but no proof establishes the claim.
A competitor in the Ashford tourney in 209 AC.

Head of House Plumm during the War of the Five Kings.
Tywin sent him and his brothers to search the riverlands for Jaime.
He joined his brothers in Tywin’s search for Jaime.
Hardstone cleared outlaws from Darry and commanded its garrison. He favoured a warhammer and spoke little.

Brown Ben led the Second Sons from Daenerys’s service to Yunkai’s, fearing her defeat. Published Winds of Winter chapters show Tyrion persuading him to change sides again. Daenerys’s dragons accepted his presence unusual
His invasion reached Oldtown but failed to take it. Visenya retaliated by burning Starfall.
Maegor rejected Benifer’s proposal that he marry the Lady of Starfall to detach her lands from Dorne.
A celebrated Sword of the Morning. Eustace Osgrey nevertheless rated Daemon Blackfyre above him.
The unnamed Lord of Starfall in the generation before Robert’s Rebellion.
The unnamed Lord of Starfall during Robert’s reign.
Betrothed to Beric Dondarrion. His repeated deaths left him unable to remember her hair colour.
Beric’s young squire befriended Arya while riding with the brotherhood. He believed his wet nurse Wylla was Jon Snow’s mother.
Darkstar escaped the failed plot to crown Myrcella. Doran blamed him for mutilating her; Hotah, Obara and Balon Swann were sent after him.
After Dalton’s murder, a quarrel over Lysa Farman ended with him killing Alester Wynch. Their occupation forces faced revolt on Fair Isle.
He killed the Reach’s lord admiral Leo Costayne during the invasion of the Iron Islands.
The Lord of Hammerhorn could muster a substantial fleet. He accepted Euron at the kingsmoot and joined the attack on the Shields.
Sent to inform the family’s other branches of Balon Greyjoy’s death.
He brought Aeron the news that Balon had died.
Gran is tall and difficult to distinguish from his identical brothers, Greydon and Gormond. He admits Aeron Greyjoy to Hammerhorn when the priest comes to speak with Gorold after Balon's death.
Gysella is one of Gorold Goodbrother's twelve daughters. She is at Hammerhorn when Aeron Greyjoy arrives, but her father sends her and her sister Gwin away before speaking with the Damphair.
Gwin is present at Hammerhorn when Aeron visits Gorold to discuss Balon's death and Euron's return. Gorold dismisses her and Gysella from the room before their conversation.
Imprisonment made him abandon Rhaenyra for Aegon II. Rhaenyra executed him when she took the capital.
Rhaenyra considered making her heir, but Corlys persuaded the queen to preserve male succession.
He inherited Stokeworth after Corlys opposed granting it to his elder sister.
Aegon’s first mistress was married off to Lucas Lothston. She later brought her young daughter Jeyne into the same king’s bed.
She accused Viserys II of poisoning Baelor to seize the crown. The accusation is unproven.
A competitor at Ashford in 209 AC.
Raped during the King’s Landing riot, she later married Bronn. Tanda’s death and Falyse’s removal made her Lady of Stokeworth.
Bronn named him after Tyrion Lannister, angering Cersei.
Lord of Pinkmaiden, otherwise unnamed in the record.
Lord of Pinkmaiden during Maegor’s reign.
Lord Petyr Piper, who died at Acorn Hall during the Dance of the Dragons, had at least one child. The child's name and sex are unknown.
Lord of Pinkmaiden; his personal history is not recorded.
Lannister raids devastated his lands at the beginning of the war.
He raided Lannister forces with Karyl Vance. The Red Wedding left him captive, later accused of resisting the Freys.
A young squire of House Piper.
A Kingsguard knight who opposed Dunk at Ashford and later accompanied Bloodraven to Whitewalls.
He found Jaime on the throne after Aerys’s murder. Reports of his death at Oxcross proved false.
Heir to Crakehall.
Strongboar survived captivity and joined Jaime’s march to Riverrun. He was subsequently sent to find the Hound.
He helped receive Oberyn Martell when the prince arrived in King’s Landing.
Her marriage to Lyonel Frey was childless. Her exact place in the Crakehall family is unknown.
Shiera married Ser Damion Lannister, a cousin of the family's main branch. Their children are Lucion and Lanna.
